descriptionChirho: Causative active sense in the Hifil stem: to hide or conceal someone or something, including with pronominal suffixes indicating the object hidden (e.g., 'hide me,' 'hide them,' 'he concealed me'); covers all Hifil finite forms, imperatives, infinitives, infinitive absolutes, and participles.

Reflexive and passive sense in the Nifal stem: to hide oneself, to be hidden, or to be concealed; includes substantival participle uses referring to hidden things or hidden faults, as well as all Nifal finite forms, imperatives, infinitives, and participles.
Reflexive-iterative sense in the Hitpael stem: to hide oneself deliberately or continuously, emphasizing the ongoing or intentional nature of the concealment; used of both human and divine subjects.
Intensive active sense in the Piel stem: to hide or conceal with care or thoroughness, representing a more deliberate or emphatic act of concealment than the basic stem.
Passive of the Piel stem: the state of being hidden or concealed, emphasizing the thoroughness or completeness of the concealment.
